__doc__: COPY ME → recordings/<id>.json, then add {id,name,tagline} to index.json. Delete the __doc__ / __*__ comment keys (JSON has no comments; the app ignores unknown keys but keep it tidy). Schema reference: BACKEND.md.
name: My Use Case
tagline: one short line shown beside the scenario tabs
concept: the 'Why it matters' callout — the single idea a viewer should walk away with.
__columns__: Ordered list of party ids = the on-screen columns. Each id MUST appear in `parties` below.
__viewers__: Who you can 'View as'. Always include 'omniscient' (god view) and 'public' (outsider: sees only kind:pub). Add any participant/authority ids.
__parties__: Self-describing actor catalogue. kind: 'inst' (participant) | 'authority' (oversight; shield + tint) | 'public' (public ledger; green).
__groupLabels__: OPTIONAL. Renames the two auto-derived column groups (participants vs public ledgers). Omit to use the defaults.
__steps__: One entry per stage, in order. plain = paragraph; tech = mono one-liner; badges = which of pub/priv this stage touches. motion (optional) animates a token between two columns.

steps.title: First stage
steps.plain: Plain-language explanation shown in the bottom rail.
steps.tech: optional mono line, e.g. an SDK call or RPC

__facts__: Ledger entries shown inside columns. Visible at step s in column c when: col==c AND from<=s AND (until==null OR s<until). kind 'pub' = on the shared/public ledger (everyone sees). kind 'priv' = restricted; list who can see it in `see`. `until` (exclusive) retires a fact; `locked` renders a lock + snap animation. `tone` for motion: 'pub' | 'priv' (add "shielded": true for hidden-amount transfers).
